Review this code/change for correctness and maintainability: <scope>

Do not rewrite it immediately. Read repository instructions and inspect surrounding contracts/callers/tests.

Prioritize concrete findings:
- correctness/logic errors;
- regressions and missing edge cases;
- authorization/security/privacy problems;
- data/concurrency/resource leaks;
- error/recovery problems;
- compatibility/migration issues;
- test gaps;
- unnecessary complexity or duplication.

For each finding give severity, exact path/symbol, realistic failure mode, and smallest remediation/test. Separate blocking defects from optional style improvements. If no blocker exists, state what was checked.
